{{Top|leg}}
The '''Min Min lights''' were unexplained sparks of light that were visible at the edge of the [[Doaba Badlands]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] during the [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of late dawn and early dusk.
